summary: Full Truck Alliance Co. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with its second-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing reports total net revenues of RMB3,381.6 million, a 4.4% increase year-over-year, and net income of RMB1,345.1 million, up 6.3%. The company highlights growth in fulfilled orders and average shipper MAUs, and mentions ongoing shareholder returns through quarterly cash dividends. This is a routine earnings announcement by the issuer, not a special-situation event. It contains no M&A, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity. The filing is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
